purpose: Probe a second QR-capable zero-secret remote MCP supplier through the official MCP Python SDK and race it against QRFlow.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet 'mcp==2.2.0'
python - <<'PY'
import asyncio,json,pathlib
from mcp import Client
URL="https://ainetcafe.com/mcp/img?s=registry"
async def main():
    async with Client(URL) as client:
        tools=await client.list_tools()
        out={"schema":"PROJECT_BRAIN_MCP_SUPPLIER_PROBE_V1","url":URL,
             "protocol_version":str(client.protocol_version),"server_info":str(client.server_info),
             "tools":[{"name":t.name,"title":getattr(t,"title",None),
                       "description":getattr(t,"description",None),
                       "input_schema":getattr(t,"input_schema",None)} for t in tools.tools]}
        p=pathlib.Path("canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-MCP-NETCAFE-QR-PROBE-001__TOOLS.json")
        p.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True,default=str)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
        print("MCP_NETCAFE_TOOLS_DISCOVERED",len(out["tools"]))
        print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True,default=str)[:12000])
asyncio.run(main())
PY
